snippet.title: Beatlow Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Beatlow on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4019820/Beatlow/
Discord: https://discord.gg/PyZHDJbKNE

Beatlow is a fast-paced rhythm game where every mistake costs a life. Hit the right keys in time with the music, survive escalating mutators, upgrade your skills, and push your run as far as possible.
